# GridWork

> An agent operating system for the terminal: one Rust binary, one append-only
> event log as the source of truth, and a TUI as the only surface. Apache-2.0,
> built in public from its first commit.

Pre-alpha, at stage 5 of 6 (Workspace). Stages 1-4 — the contract, the kernel,
the engines, and the console — are done. Schemas, protocols, and the binary
change without notice until 1.0.

The site at https://gridwork.sh is a curated mirror of documents in the public
repository; the repository is canonical, and every docs page links the exact
source files it was curated from.

## What runs today

- `gwk-cert` replays an exported event stream against the contract. It proves
  contract conformance, NOT authenticity — a coherent forged stream passes.
- `cargo install gridwork` installs the headless `gw` CLI. It needs a
  PostgreSQL 16 and two separate database roles before it does anything.
- `gw tui` opens five lenses — hall, work, fleet, flow, term — over the
  kernel's live projections.

Not built: the workspace multiplexer (stage 5, in progress), the
ledger-synced exportable half of replay, and packaging for the PTY engine host.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://gridwork.sh/docs/quickstart): certify a stream, install
  the CLI, initialize a kernel, and the current limits.
- [Architecture](https://gridwork.sh/docs/architecture): what owns truth, what
  the pieces are, which decisions are locked.
- [Protocol](https://gridwork.sh/docs/protocol): the client-kernel contract —
  framing, hello, requests, subscriptions.
- [Contract naming](https://gridwork.sh/docs/contract): the casing and
  wire-shape rules the contract is frozen under.
- [Threat model](https://gridwork.sh/docs/security): every boundary labelled
  in force, partial, or designed-not-yet-built.
- [Engine parity](https://gridwork.sh/docs/parity): the twelve-cell matrix.
  It runs LOCALLY, never in public CI — its tests need three logged-in engine
  CLIs, and cells are only valid against the versions pinned at capture time.
  Public CI proves the adapter crates build and handle recorded frames.
- [Clean-room derivation](https://gridwork.sh/docs/derivation): the
  independent-implementation policy for terminal-engine work.
- [Roadmap](https://gridwork.sh/docs/roadmap): six stages and what each
  delivers.

## Repository

- Source: https://github.com/GridWork-dev/gridwork
- Crates: https://crates.io/crates/gridwork — six crates published at 0.0.2
  (gwk-domain, gwk-cert, gwk-theme, gwk-kernel, gridwork, gwk). The PTY engine,
  the three engine adapters, the parity harness, and the TUI are in the tree
  and deliberately unpublished until 1.0 packaging.
- Stable Rust, MSRV 1.94. 1,125 test functions across the workspace as of
  2026-08-12.

## Provenance

Most commits are agent-authored under human direction and review. This is
stated as a fact, not a caveat — the same gates apply regardless of who typed
the code.
